_doc: Map 4 'Fernflug' Act III: Groom Lake, Nevada (UPDATE 07, docs/MAP4_FERNFLUG.md §5, DECISIONS T-110/T-111). map_key: the story-prop / intel key. act: the act block (rounds are ACT-RELATIVE: act round n = match round - act_start + 1, 'ACT III · 1' is match round 21 in a campaign run and round 1 on its own). special_kind dust_storm: the GroomController runs the special rounds (the fog closes in, Burrowers double). boss: the Test Pilot, reserved on act round 6 (match 26), arena the lab's long hall (he waits a round while the lab is shut). events.rocket_fallback_round: on act round 9 the key, the burn and the rocket are given if the squad never earned them. power: the generator in the motor pool's shed. groom: the act's systems (gravelight/world/map04/groom_controller.gd): the enemies' kits and rounds, the dust storm, the wreck's fire, the kill plane. exfil: the gantry lift in the silo (Act III → Act IV): lit on act round 9 (`act_round`; `round` 29 is the nominal match round) or by the flag rocket_ready (the console: the key turned, the burn entered); the lift needs rocket_ready too.

spawn_table._doc: windows = the torn hull, the hangar's and the motor pool's hatches, the tower's rise, the lab's vents, the silo's duct (closets outside); ground = emerge points; catwalk = the six BURROW points on the salt (Catwalk_B_LAKEBED_n: ground spawns the GroomController walks toward the players on the lake bed).

groom._doc: The act's systems. kill_plane_y: the silo shaft and the trench are deep. fire: the wreck's burning wing root, a damage zone of radius m at one of points, moving every move_every s (dps on players). burrower: Gängers rising at the lakebed's burrow points from from_act_round; the points walk to near_min..near_max m of a player on the salt every relocate_every s. canary: from from_act_round in zones, a chance per spawn (max_active): health_mult, torso_mult, the hood gas (gas_radius / gas_seconds / gas_dps / gas_status) on a head kill. jumpjockey: from from_act_round in zones: health_mult, a leap of leap_min..leap_max m taking air_seconds, every cooldown s, from within launch_near_m of a launch point (after 8 s anyway); the landing hits land_radius for land_damage and pushes land_push. backorder: from from_act_round once requires_flag (or relay_coil_taken) is set, max_active, a chance per spawn; solid for solid_seconds within solidify_at_m of its target; kill_scrip on top of the kill. dust_storm: the special round (the director's gap; banner, lines, the fog, a burrow pack every spawn_gap s). events.rocket_fallback_round: act-relative.

fire._doc_spread: U10 §3 (T-157): the fuel fire spreads one node per act round from from_act_round (both lists grow together; the loop past round 9 keeps them at their ends). wing: flames along the torn port wing (seen from the salt, no damage: nobody walks there); hull: along the hull's west wall inside, a damage disc of radius at dps each.

wreck_collapse._doc: U10 §3 (T-157, contract C6 wreck_collapse): sections of the Kranich fall on act_round (3 and 6 = match 23 / 26 in a campaign), telegraphed warn_s ahead (groans, falling sparks over the box). At the fall: players in box are pushed toward push_to first (nobody is crushed), zombies under it die (no Scrip), debris colliders fill debris (boxes [lo, hi]) and the wreck's navmesh region (nav_region) is re-baked round them. seal_window: the window's spawn and boards are closed by the debris. crate_spot: a new Mystery Crate spot opens [pos, yaw]. gap: the plate (a gameplay StaticBody) falls out of the bulkhead and a NavigationLink opens on the zone's layer; open_door is bought for free if it is still shut.

dust_storm._doc_u10: UPDATE 10 §3 (T-157): the storm is the round every every_act_rounds act rounds (5, 10...); visibility_m sets the fog (density 3/vis); sky_dim / ambient_dim / sun_dim darken it; hud_line shows once per match. hear: the stalkers (kinds: the Burrowers and the plain Gängers "" in the surface zones) hunt by sound: radius_m, x loud_mult while a player sprints or fired in the last fire_window_s.
dust_storm.hud_line: DUST STORM: they hunt by sound
